name: Enchanted Forest
description: A mystical forest filled with ancient trees, magical creatures, and hidden treasures.

name: Caverns
description: A vast network of underground passages with glowing crystals, mysterious echoes, and creatures that have adapted to life without sunlight.

name: Catacombs
description: Ancient burial chambers that wind deep beneath the earth, filled with forgotten history, restless spirits, and treasures left with the dead.

name: Volcanic Wastes
description: A hellish landscape of lava flows and ash clouds. Extremely dangerous but rewarding for brave adventurers.

name: Drakkesh Fort
description: A massive fortress built into the side of a mountain, once home to a mighty military force. Now overrun with bandits and mercenaries guarding stolen treasures.

name: Oomshru Kingdom
description: The hidden realm of the Oomshru, an ancient race with advanced magic and technology. Their cities are marvels of crystal and light, but they don't welcome outsiders.

name: Ancient Ruins
description: The remains of a once-great civilization, now overrun with traps and guardians protecting forgotten treasures.

name: Abyssal Realm
description: A twisted dimension where reality itself is warped. Strange creatures of immense power roam freely, and the laws of nature don't apply. Only the most powerful adventurers dare enter.
